notes: *even you*: I gave *even* to the appositional bĕ, which stands on the very phrase the word introduces. Rule 16's third family gives an appositional *As for* to a fronting lĕ under rule 11, which is the same reasoning; the competing reading (*even* `added`, the preposition unrepresented) is named in that unit's note.
The first bĕ is unrepresented because the ASV promotes its object to a bare direct object (rule 40's *blew the trumpet* case).
*as at this day* is read as at DEU.10.10, with *as at* one compound rendering of kĕ and the demonstrative holding the phrase's only determiner.
